description: Create a new local npm repository in JFrog Artifactory with the following settings: Repository Key: 'npm-local', Package Type: npm, Description: 'Local npm package repository'. Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 using username 'admin' and password 'password'. Navigate to Administration > Repositories > Add Repositories > Local Repository, select npm as the package type, enter the repository key 'npm-local', add the description 'Local npm package repository', and save. The repository must appear in the repositories list when done.
